name: yld-skills
description: YLD Claude skills. Install a team plugin to get all of that team's skills, or install a single skill on its own.

plugins.name: yld-engineering
plugins.description: YLD engineering skills: investigations, reports and ways to reframe work for different readers.

plugins.name: yld-design
plugins.description: YLD Product Design skills: design system work, research synthesis and project updates.

plugins.name: yld-marketing
plugins.description: YLD Marketing skills: campaign and event planning.

plugins.name: yld-cp
plugins.description: YLD Client Partner skills: client business reviews.

plugins.name: yld-general
plugins.description: YLD skills for any team, including writing new skills.

plugins.name: eli5
plugins.description: Explain any topic, code, concept, or error tailored to a specific audience's level of understanding.

plugins.name: forensic-investigation
plugins.description: Use when an incident needs investigating — a breach, credential abuse, unexpected spend or traffic, suspicious activity, data exposure — and the user asks to investigate, establish what happened, collect evidence, or build a timeline.

plugins.name: forensic-report
plugins.description: Use when writing, assembling or validating a forensic report or report package — after evidence has been collected, when the user asks to write up an investigation, produce findings, review a draft report, or check a package before release.

plugins.name: table-me
plugins.description: Turn prose already discussed in this conversation into a comparison table, so the differences between the options become visible at a glance.

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Cut AI tells from any writing.

plugins.name: zoom-out
plugins.description: Tell the agent to zoom out and give broader context or a higher-level perspective.

plugins.name: compare-ds-components
plugins.description: Compares the same component (button, input, tabs, card) across two design systems from their Figma frames and writes a gap analysis with requirements to bring one system up to par.

plugins.name: component-documentation
plugins.description: Reads a design system component set in Figma and writes its documentation frame into the same file, beside the component - anatomy, every property and state, usage, accessibility and nested components.

plugins.name: ds-pr-review
plugins.description: Reviews a UI pull request against design system rules and writes one comment grouped by severity.

plugins.name: eow-summary
plugins.description: Turns a project's Kanban board (Jira, Notion, Trello or pasted tickets) into a plain text end-of-week update email for stakeholders, grouped by discipline, with a TL;DR, this week's work and next week's plan.

plugins.name: interview-insights
plugins.description: Turns a client interview or discovery call transcript into a list of every problem and need raised, each attributed to the person who said it, with a second pass for anything missed and a list of unclear comments.

plugins.name: campaign-plan
plugins.description: Turns event or campaign inputs (contract, brief, previous plan format, RACI) into a first-draft campaign plan for Notion with objectives, owners, budget and timeline.

plugins.name: business-review-prep
plugins.description: Drafts the slide content for a client business review from our documentation, financials and team input, tailored to what the client values most.

plugins.name: skill-to-notion
plugins.description: Turns a workshop board (a task broken into six blocks, pasted as rough text from Miro) into a finished SKILL.md and a matching Notion skill page in the YLD format.
